title: Add scroll option for the query output container
steps:
1. Click Workbench 
2. Click Spark SQL 
3.  Select --> default > Sales Summary.
expected: User should be able to scroll the query container to see all the queries.
actual: The Spark SQL results panel fails to return the requested number of records. When executing a query with a LIMIT 30 clause, the output container truncates the data and is only able to see 12 rows. Unable to scroll the query container.
